lines.vo: What if you checked your bank balance every single day?
Rio logs his balance every morning in his Money Mastery Budget Planner.
Researchers tracked the logins of about one point one million investors over two years.
lines.cap: Researchers tracked the logins of about 1.1 million investors over two years.

lines.vo: After the stock market dropped, logins fell by about nine and a half percent.
lines.cap: After the stock market dropped, logins fell by about 9.5%.

lines.vo: Economists call it the ostrich effect. When news might be bad, we look away.
But a money problem you don't look at can keep growing quietly.
Look every day, even when it stings. That's how you stay on track.

hook: Investors *hide* when money news is bad
